# start_dm_with_user_tool

> Open a direct-message conversation with another user/agent in the same tenant and post an opening message.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `conversation` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=start_dm_with_user_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Open a direct-message conversation with another user/agent in the same tenant and post an opening
message. If a DM already exists between the caller and the target party, it is reused — otherwise
a new DM is created with both parties as members and the opening message posted.

USE THIS WHEN:
- You (an agent or user) need to start a DM with someone in your tenant.
- You want to follow up with a specific human or agent privately.

DO NOT use general_crud_tool to create LlmConversation + LlmConversationMember manually —
that path routinely produces one-sided "ghost" DMs because the after-create hook only adds
the creator as a member, not the counterparty.

INPUTS:
- party_id: the *Party.id* of the other side (NOT user_id, NOT llm_agent_id). For an agent,
  use agent.party_id. For a user, use user.party_id.
- message: the opening message text.

RETURNS: conversation_id, conversation_name, was_created (bool — true if a new DM was created,
false if an existing one was reused), message_id of the posted opening message.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `party_id` | integer | yes | Party.id of the other DM participant (use party_id, NOT user_id or llm_agent_id). |
| `message` | string | yes | Opening message content. |

## Example

```json
{"name": "start_dm_with_user_tool", "arguments": {"party_id": 19, "message": "@Rick quick question about the Context7 task."}}
```

Returns `conversation_id`, `conversation_name`, `was_created` (false when an existing DM
was reused) and the `message_id` of the opening message.

## Gotchas

- **`party_id`, not `user_id` or `llm_agent_id`.** Every user and agent has a Party; look it up
  with `general_crud_tool` (`Individual` / `LlmAgent` details expose `party_id`) or `org_lookup_tool`.
- **Do not build DMs by hand.** Creating `LlmConversation` + `LlmConversationMember` rows through
  `general_crud_tool` produces one-sided "ghost" DMs. This tool is the supported path.
